verdict.rationale: Qapita's own docs describe cap table management as a single source of truth for founders, investors and employees, with a real-time view of ownership. They also cover issuing, tracking and modeling equity, and managing option grants, vesting and exercises. Audit-ready financial reporting supports the auditor-reliance angle. However, the evidence never mentions share classes, share certificates or SAFEs, and all items are short marketing taglines rather than in-depth documentation. missing for 10: explicit share class support, certificate issuance/tracking, SAFE/convertible instrument handling, in-depth product documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
